catalog_source.integration: independent reimplementation of the Engle-Granger idea; repository code is not executed or copied

formation.frequency: first available trading close of each calendar quarter
formation.pair_direction: alphabetically first ticker is x and second is y
formation.selection_order: lowest cointegration p-value then shortest half-life then ticker identity

trading.break_stop_behavior: exit and disable pair until next quarterly formation
trading.weights: 50 percent long cheap leg and 50 percent short expensive leg
trading.portfolio: equal gross risk across active pairs with total gross exposure at most 1 and net exposure 0

frictions.turnover: sum absolute change in long and short asset weights

negative_controls: inverted spread direction on the same selected pairs
deterministic random disjoint pairs matched to selected pair count

portfolio_comparison.primary_pair_sleeve: real pair strategy at 50 bps and 3 percent annual borrow
portfolio_comparison.diagnostic_core_blend: 80 percent frozen core and 20 percent pair sleeve

promotion_gates.pair_annual_return: greater than zero at 50 bps and 3 percent borrow
promotion_gates.pair_sharpe: greater than 0.5 at 50 bps and 3 percent borrow
promotion_gates.later_windows: 2016-2020 and 2021-present both positive at primary costs
promotion_gates.stress: positive annual return at 100 bps and 8 percent borrow
promotion_gates.controls: real Sharpe greater than inverted random-pair and stale controls
promotion_gates.dependence: absolute weekly correlation to frozen core no greater than 0.3
promotion_gates.blend: 20 percent blend point Sharpe above core with no worse drawdown and paired Sharpe lower bound greater than zero
